title: PLC #4 — Tractor Engine (J1939)
description: Engine telemetry decoded from the JD 5055E CAN bus. PROPOSED, not deployed. Reads plc4_engine, plc4_dtc_* and the views v_plc4_engine_now, v_plc4_can_health, v_plc4_dm1_now from migration 067 (070 on the consumer side). Every tile tells three things apart: NO DATA (board silent), 'not reported' (the latest message omitted the value) and a real 0. Revised 2026-09-22 after the first field run of image 19f0c022.

target.rawSql: SELECT recv_ts AS time, CASE WHEN counter_reset THEN 'board counters reset (reboot)' WHEN publish_gap THEN 'publish gap ' || round(gap_s) || ' s' ELSE 'hardware filter ' || CASE WHEN filt THEN 'ON' ELSE 'OFF' END END AS text, 'plc4' AS tags FROM v_plc4_can_health WHERE $__timeFilter(recv_ts) AND (reboot OR (prev_ts IS NOT NULL AND filt IS DISTINCT FROM prev_filt)) ORDER BY recv_ts

panels.title: Tractor state
panels.description: From v_plc4_engine_now.state_code. 0 BOARD SILENT: no engine message for over 50 s (or never). 1 CAN DOWN: the last CAN.begin() failed. 2 CAN ?: first row after a reboot or publish gap, no rate yet. 3 BUS QUIET: no frames in the last interval -- key off OR a CAN fault; the two cannot be told apart until BRIEF Q8 (switched or maintained board power) is answered. 4 KEY ON, ENGINE OFF: rpm reported 0. 5 CRANKING: 0 < rpm < 400. 6 RUNNING: rpm >= 400. 7 RUNNING, rpm not reported: no rpm, but oil >= 100 kPa, fuel >= 0.5 L/h or keyswitch >= 13.5 V (image 19f0c022 reads like this). 8 KEY ON, rpm not reported. ' - LOW OIL' is appended when running is confirmed on two rows and oil is under plc4_alert_threshold.oil_kpa_low (which ships NULL, so it cannot appear until that limit is set). Cut points 400 rpm / 100 kPa / 0.5 L/h / 13.5 V are PLACEHOLDERS taken from values observed on this tractor, not John Deere specifications.

targets.rawSql: SELECT state_text AS "state", CASE WHEN has_row THEN round(age_s)::int END AS "last heard (s ago)" FROM v_plc4_engine_now

panels.title: Faults
panels.description: From v_plc4_dm1_now, one row per ECU (SA 3, 6, 23, 71 always listed). Priority: RED STOP > PROTECT > AMBER > MIL > N CODES > CLEAR - k ECUs > NO DM1 RECEIVED. ', CODE WITHHELD' is appended when a lamp is 1 while that ECU reports n = 0 -- that is NOT clear. Lamp values 2 (reserved) and 3 (not available) never count as lit. 'as of' is the newest DM1 the consumer received: DM1 is sent on change and retained, so an old time is normal and is not a fault.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN bool_or(rsl_on) THEN 'RED STOP' WHEN bool_or(pl_on) THEN 'PROTECT' WHEN bool_or(awl_on) THEN 'AMBER' WHEN bool_or(mil_on) THEN 'MIL' WHEN COALESCE(sum(n), 0) > 0 THEN sum(n) || ' CODES' WHEN bool_or(received) THEN 'CLEAR - ' || count(*) FILTER (WHERE received) || ' ECUs' ELSE 'NO DM1 RECEIVED' END || CASE WHEN bool_or(lamp_lit_no_code) THEN ', CODE WITHHELD' ELSE '' END AS "faults", (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM max(recv_ts)) * 1000)::bigint AS "as of" FROM v_plc4_dm1_now

panels.title: Engine speed
panels.description: SPN 190 (EEC1). Latest row only, never carried forward. NO DATA = no engine message in the last 50 s (see Tractor state); 'not reported' = the latest message omitted it (engine did not broadcast it, or the value arrived unusable -- ingest_unmapped says which); 0 is a real 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT rpm AS "rpm" FROM v_plc4_engine_now WHERE NOT board_silent

panels.title: Oil pressure
panels.description: SPN 100, 4 kPa per bit -- the value moves in 4 kPa steps. No colour on the raw value: the field's crank row read 0 kPa and that is normal. The low-oil judgement is the view's (running confirmed on two rows AND oil under plc4_alert_threshold.oil_kpa_low); the limit ships NULL, so the check reads 'limit not set' until a JD figure is entered. Latest row only, never carried forward. NO DATA = no engine message in the last 50 s (see Tractor state); 'not reported' = the latest message omitted it (engine did not broadcast it, or the value arrived unusable -- ingest_unmapped says which); 0 is a real 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT oil_kpa AS "oil", CASE WHEN oil_kpa_low IS NULL THEN 'limit not set' WHEN oil_low_running THEN 'LOW' WHEN running_confirmed THEN 'ok' ELSE 'not running' END AS "low-oil check" FROM v_plc4_engine_now WHERE NOT board_silent

panels.title: Coolant
panels.description: SPN 110. Neutral colour below the limit. The limit is plc4_alert_threshold.coolant_c_high, which ships NULL (no JD figure yet) -- the earlier 100/110 C lines had no source and are gone. Latest row only, never carried forward. NO DATA = no engine message in the last 50 s (see Tractor state); 'not reported' = the latest message omitted it (engine did not broadcast it, or the value arrived unusable -- ingest_unmapped says which); 0 is a real 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coolant_c AS "coolant", CASE WHEN coolant_c_high IS NULL THEN 'limit not set' WHEN coolant_high THEN 'HIGH' WHEN coolant_c IS NOT NULL THEN 'below limit' END AS "vs limit" FROM v_plc4_engine_now WHERE NOT board_silent

panels.title: Battery
panels.description: Keyswitch potential, SPN 158 -- the 5055E's real battery reading. 'charging' at 13.5 V or above (placeholder from the field: 12.40 V key-on, 14.25 V running). batt_v (SPN 168) is not shown: it is FFFF in every VEP1 frame of the census. Latest row only, never carried forward. NO DATA = no engine message in the last 50 s (see Tractor state); 'not reported' = the latest message omitted it (engine did not broadcast it, or the value arrived unusable -- ingest_unmapped says which); 0 is a real 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT keysw_v AS "battery", CASE WHEN keysw_v >= 13.5 THEN 'charging' WHEN keysw_v IS NOT NULL THEN 'not charging' END AS "status" FROM v_plc4_engine_now WHERE NOT board_silent

panels.title: Fuel rate
panels.description: SPN 183, 0.05 L/h per bit. Latest row only, never carried forward. NO DATA = no engine message in the last 50 s (see Tractor state); 'not reported' = the latest message omitted it (engine did not broadcast it, or the value arrived unusable -- ingest_unmapped says which); 0 is a real 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT fuel_lph AS "fuel" FROM v_plc4_engine_now WHERE NOT board_silent

panels.title: Engine hours
panels.description: SPN 247. NOT broadcast on this tractor: the engine sends it only in answer to requests from other ECUs (SA 0x06, 0x17) -- a pair every 30 s once running, 1 Hz for ~5 s at power-up (census). This board never transmits, so hours are only as fresh as those requests. The ONLY carried-forward tile: the newest non-NULL hours value and when it arrived. On image 19f0c022 hours appeared in only 4 of 8 messages (clock-ordering bug plus a 5 s window); the next flashed image (after 705bf3c) uses a 90 s window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT hours_last AS "hours", (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM hours_ts) * 1000)::bigint AS "as of" FROM v_plc4_engine_now

panels.title: CAN link
panels.description: Frames per second over the last interval (v_plc4_can_health, consumer wall clock). 0 = BUS QUIET. Red below 1 fps -- never a fraction of the ~460 fps seen here, because the hardware filter is expected to cut it to ~140 fps. 'DROPPING' = the receive ring was found full in the last interval (frames lost). 'filtered' = hardware filter on. NO DATA = board silent.

targets.rawSql: SELECT fps AS "fps", NULLIF(concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN d_ring_full > 0 THEN 'DROPPING' END, CASE WHEN filt THEN 'filtered' END, CASE WHEN fps IS NULL THEN 'no rate yet' END), '') AS "link" FROM v_plc4_engine_now WHERE NOT board_silent

panels.title: State over time
panels.description: Same codes and colours as the Tractor state tile. Each bucket (15 s, or the panel interval if coarser) takes the newest row in the 50 s before it; a bucket with none is BOARD SILENT. LOW OIL is not drawn here. Cut points 400 rpm / 100 kPa / 0.5 L/h / 13.5 V are PLACEHOLDERS taken from values observed on this tractor, not John Deere specifications.

targets.rawSql: SELECT b.t AS time, COALESCE(h.state_code, 0) AS "state" FROM generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz, make_interval(secs => greatest(15, $__interval_ms / 1000.0))) AS b(t) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT state_code FROM v_plc4_can_health WHERE recv_ts <= b.t AND recv_ts > b.t - interval '50 seconds' ORDER BY recv_ts DESC LIMIT 1) h ON true ORDER BY 1

panels.title: RPM, load, torque and fuel
panels.description: rpm SPN 190 (left); load SPN 92 and torque SPN 513 (percent, right); fuel SPN 183 (L/h, right). Absent values are breaks, never zeros: no IS NOT NULL filter, spanNulls off, and a gap over 50 s between messages breaks the line too. Image 19f0c022 omitted rpm on most rows (the freshness bug fixed in the next flashed image (after 705bf3c)), so expect breaks before that flash.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recv_ts AS time, rpm AS "rpm", load_pct AS "load %", torque_pct AS "torque %", fuel_lph AS "fuel L/h" FROM plc4_engine WHERE $__timeFilter(recv_ts) ORDER BY recv_ts

panels.title: Oil pressure and coolant
panels.description: Oil (kPa, left): the faint line is every row; the bold line is only rows where running is confirmed on this and the previous row, which hides the crank dip (field 19:41:20: 161 rpm, 0 kPa). Coolant (C, right). Dashed limit lines come from plc4_alert_threshold and are empty while the limits are NULL, as shipped. Oil temperature (SPN 175) is hidden: ET1 bytes 3-4 are FFFF in the census, so it is expected absent. Absent values are breaks, never zeros: no IS NOT NULL filter, spanNulls off, and a gap over 50 s between messages breaks the line too.

targets.rawSql: SELECT h.recv_ts AS time, h.oil_kpa AS "oil (all rows)", CASE WHEN h.running_confirmed THEN h.oil_kpa END AS "oil (running confirmed)", h.coolant_c AS "coolant", h.oil_temp_c AS "oil temp (expected absent)", t.oil_kpa_low AS "oil low limit", t.coolant_c_high AS "coolant high limit" FROM v_plc4_can_health h CROSS JOIN (SELECT max(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'oil_kpa_low') AS oil_kpa_low, max(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'coolant_c_high') AS coolant_c_high, max(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'keysw_v_charge_min') AS keysw_v_charge_min FROM plc4_alert_threshold) t WHERE $__timeFilter(h.recv_ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Battery trend
panels.description: Keyswitch potential, SPN 158. Bands: below 12.4 V (under the field's key-on reading), 12.4-13.5 V (key on, not charging), 13.5 V and up (charging). Band edges are placeholders from the field, not JD figures. batt_v (SPN 168) is hidden: FFFF in every census VEP1 frame. Absent values are breaks, never zeros: no IS NOT NULL filter, spanNulls off, and a gap over 50 s between messages breaks the line too.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recv_ts AS time, keysw_v AS "battery (SPN 158)", batt_v AS "SPN 168 (expected empty)" FROM plc4_engine WHERE $__timeFilter(recv_ts) ORDER BY recv_ts

panels.title: Signal coverage while the bus is live
panels.description: Of the rows whose interval saw frames (d_frames > 0), the percentage that carry each value. Target 100%. oil_temp_c and batt_v are left out because they are always absent on this tractor. THIS IS THE ACCEPTANCE CHECK AFTER FLASHING THE NEXT FLASHED IMAGE (AFTER 705BF3C): image 19f0c022 showed rpm in 0 of 8 key-on messages, hours in 4 of 8, fuel in 6 of 8. Set the time range to after the flash to judge the new image alone. load/torque at key-on engine-off: whether EEC2 is broadcast then has not been checked, so a gap there may be the tractor, not the board.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(rpm) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "rpm", round(100.0 * count(load_pct) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "load_pct", round(100.0 * count(torque_pct) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "torque_pct", round(100.0 * count(coolant_c) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "coolant_c", round(100.0 * count(oil_kpa) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "oil_kpa", round(100.0 * count(fuel_lph) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "fuel_lph", round(100.0 * count(keysw_v) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "keysw_v", round(100.0 * count(hours) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "hours" FROM v_plc4_can_health WHERE $__timeFilter(recv_ts) AND d_frames > 0

panels.title: Lamps per ECU
panels.description: v_plc4_dm1_now. SA 3, 6, 23 and 71 are always listed; 'never received' means that ECU has not published DM1 to this consumer. Lamps: 0 off, 1 ON, 2 reserved and 3 not available are grey and never lit. 'delivery' retained = the broker replayed the last DM1 on reconnect, not a new message from the ECU. 'since last DM1 publish' is not ECU liveness: DM1 is sent on change.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sa AS "ECU (SA)", CASE WHEN received THEN 'received' ELSE 'never received' END AS "DM1", n AS "codes", mil AS "MIL", rsl AS "Red stop", awl AS "Amber", pl AS "Protect", recv_ts AS "as of", ts_kind AS "delivery", since_publish_s AS "since last DM1 publish (s)" FROM v_plc4_dm1_now ORDER BY sa

panels.title: Active DTCs
panels.description: v_plc4_dtc_active: the newest DM1 per ECU, one row per code. A row with an empty SPN is a no-fault snapshot (or a lit lamp with no code -- see Lamps per ECU). 'since last DM1 publish' counts from the last live publish or retained redelivery; it is not ECU liveness.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sa AS "ECU", recv_ts AS "reported", age_s AS "since last DM1 publish (s)", ts_kind AS "delivery", n AS "count", spn AS "SPN", fmi AS "FMI", oc AS "occurrences" FROM v_plc4_dtc_active ORDER BY sa, spn NULLS FIRST

panels.title: Frames per second
panels.description: fps (wall) = d_frames / seconds between messages, by the consumer's clock. fps (board clock) = d_frames x 200 / d_drains, timed by the board's own 200 Hz drain timer, so network jitter drops out. Rows from 19f0c022 carry no drains, so the board-clock line is empty there by design. Measured: ~441-444 fps around crank, 454.8 key-on engine off on 19f0c022; census 458.6 key-on, 465 idle.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recv_ts AS time, fps AS "fps (wall)", fps_board AS "fps (board clock)" FROM v_plc4_can_health WHERE $__timeFilter(recv_ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Drains per second
panels.description: How often the 200 Hz drain ISR ran; expected ~200. The drain-stalled alert fires below 100, and only when drains is reported (image e82bcb7 on) -- empty on 19f0c022 rows by design.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recv_ts AS time, drains_ps AS "drains/s" FROM v_plc4_can_health WHERE $__timeFilter(recv_ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ring full and CAN errors, per interval
panels.description: d_ring_full: drains that found the 32-slot ring full in the interval -- each one means frames were lost. d_can_err: driver error events in the interval. Field 19f0c022: both 0 throughout. NULL on reboot/gap rows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recv_ts AS time, d_ring_full AS "ring full", d_can_err AS "CAN errors" FROM v_plc4_can_health WHERE $__timeFilter(recv_ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ring high-water mark
panels.description: Deepest the receive ring has been since boot, out of 32. A running maximum: it only falls on reboot. Field 19f0c022: 9 of 32 throughout.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recv_ts AS time, ring_high AS "ring high-water (of 32)" FROM v_plc4_can_health WHERE $__timeFilter(recv_ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Last CAN error
panels.description: can_last: the last driver error event, as r_can_api.h can_event_t (Arduino renesas_uno 1.6.0). 'not reported' = the image predates the key (before e82bcb7, including 19f0c022) or it arrived unusable. NO DATA = board silent.

targets.rawSql: SELECT can_last AS "last CAN error" FROM v_plc4_engine_now WHERE NOT board_silent

panels.title: Unknown-frame fraction
panels.description: d_unknown / d_frames per interval: the share of bus traffic the decoder does not use. With the hardware filter off it is ~0.8 (census). 'filter on' is 1 while filt is true.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recv_ts AS time, unknown_frac AS "unknown fraction", CASE WHEN filt THEN 1 WHEN filt IS FALSE THEN 0 END AS "filter on" FROM v_plc4_can_health WHERE $__timeFilter(recv_ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Filter off vs on
panels.description: Evidence for the first canf trial (the verb needs the USB console on farm1). Bus-live rows only; the row where filt changes is left out because its interval mixes both settings. PREDICTED, FROM THE HOST REPLAY ONLY (census candump-2026-09-22_175858.log through test/test_j1939_replay.cpp): filter on ~140 fps, unknown fraction ~0.18 (1921 of 10477 passed frames unused), and no frame the decoder uses is dropped -- so rpm and hours dropout should not rise. Not measured on the board.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN filt THEN 'filter ON' WHEN filt IS FALSE THEN 'filter OFF' ELSE 'unknown' END AS "filter", count(*) AS "bus-live rows", round(avg(fps)::numeric, 1) AS "mean fps", round(avg(unknown_frac)::numeric, 3) AS "unknown fraction", round(100 - 100.0 * count(rpm) / count(*), 1) AS "rpm dropout %", round(100 - 100.0 * count(hours) / count(*), 1) AS "hours dropout %" FROM v_plc4_can_health WHERE $__timeFilter(recv_ts) AND d_frames > 0 AND filt IS NOT DISTINCT FROM prev_filt GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
